threats.title: Former volunteer uses shared dispatch login
threats.description: if the shared dispatch credentials still valid after the volunteer leave, the volunteer could sign in as dispatch
threats.mitigation: Give volunteers individual and download-only portal accounts.When the volunteer leaves, prohibit each account.

threats.title: CSV download cannot be attributed to a person
threats.description: Shared accounts make it hard to identify who downloaded a css
threats.mitigation: Log volunteer ID,download time, and CSV version

threats.title: Automated submissions
threats.description: Bots may overwhelm the public delivery form
threats.mitigation: Apply rate limits and flag repeated submissions
